definitions.explanation: A small pocket of air or gas trapped in a liquid, solid, or other material. Used in both everyday and scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{気泡|きほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: You can see small air bubbles inside the glass.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンクリート→コンクリート：10858_konkuriito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気泡|きほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{強度|きょうど}→強度：27803_kyoudo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: If air bubbles get into concrete, the strength decreases, so care is needed.

notes:
Refers specifically to bubbles of air or gas, whether in liquids, solids, or materials. More precise and technical than ⟦{泡|あわ}→泡：02175_awa⟧, which is the general word for foam or bubbles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気泡|きほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ — for air bubbles to get in
- {気泡|きほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ — for bubbles to form
- {気泡|きほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧ — to remove air bubbles
- {気泡|きほう}⟦{緩衝材|かんしょうざい}→緩衝材：18884_kanshouzai⟧ — bubble wrap (bubble cushioning material)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{泡|あわ}→泡：02175_awa⟧ — bubble, foam; the everyday general word for bubbles, including soap bubbles and foam on beer
- {水泡|すいほう} — water bubble; also used figuratively in {水泡|すいほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{帰|き}する (to come to nothing)
- {泡沫|うたかた} — ephemeral bubble; literary word suggesting something fleeting
